For the record, I did not refresh the page or click Forward the Back in my browser.

Here's how I did it:

1) Comment on a thread.

2) Block someone who has also commented on the thread. In my case, I had already blocked SaneGoatiSwear.

3) Navigate to "https://voat.co/user/[YOURUSERNAME]/comments".

4) Scroll down until you find your comment from that thread and then click "context".

5) Click "reply" to reply to a comment, type something, then click "Submit reply"

Result: You should get a double-post of the same comment.

Expected result: Your comment should only be posted once.

For the deleting bit, all I did was click "delete" then "yes" on the second instance of the post and both instances of the post were deleted.
